implement.approach: Defect on BASE (VERIFIED by the base run): supabase/functions/api/index.ts registerOfflineDevice() calls register_offline_device(..., p_attested: false) so every 1.0 installation is 'unattested'; supabase/migrations/20260908160000_offline_device_grants.sql issue_offline_grant() lines ~1535-1539 return 'offline.device_not_attested' for any device whose attestation_state <> 'attested', and guard_offline_grant() lines ~221-227 refuse any grant row whose device is not 'attested'; the Edge route mapped that result to 403 'Offline grants are issued only to attested installations.' Fix: forward migration 20260910140000 (never edits the applied one): offline_grants.attestation_state text not null check in ('attested','unattested'), backfilled 'attested' (the only state the old guard ever admitted) with the default dropped; offline_devices.revoked_at timestamptz; guard_offline_grant() looks the device up by (id, user_id) as before, refuses revoked_at, fails closed on an unknown state, stamps new.attestation_state from the device row and refuses a caller-supplied mismatch (so no grant claims a state the server did not record), keeps the Pro-entitlement and immutability checks verbatim; issue_offline_grant() dropped/recreated (return table gains attestation_state) with the 20260908160000 body verbatim except 'unattested' is no longer a refusal and revoked_at -> 'offline.device_revoked' (owner+installation lookup, api_private.is_active_session(), access_lock_key(uid), Pro lease = min(now+7d, verified expiry), free tickets within lifetime_scored_count()+online_reservation_count()+offline_hold_count() <= 2, original-installation recovery; EXECUTE re-granted to authenticated only). Edge: OFFLINE_GRANT_REFUSALS maps offline.device_revoked -> 403; an accepted row without attestation_state in {attested, unattested} is refused with a generic 503 + row_malformed audit; attestationState is echoed in the clear response/audit; the signed claims contract (packages/shared-types offlineAuthorization) is untouched and carries no attestation claim (asserted on the decoded JWS payload). Mobile parseIssuedOfflineGrant() ignores the extra clear field (INFERRED from apps/mobile/src/data/api.ts:607-653). review.summary: APPROVE W04-06 candidate fbc1cc99 (base d446dcdd). Scope: 5 files under write_paths plus a 2-line additive fixture edit in supabase/functions/api/__wf__/offline_key_rotation.test.ts (GrantRow type + proRow() gain attestation_state) — judged justified wiring: __wf__ is not under any serial_group_paths prefix, no assertion changed, and it is the minimum needed because the shipping route now fails closed (503) on an accepted row without a known attestation state. Behaviour is shipped, not dead code: index.ts issueOfflineGrant() consumes the new RPC column, maps offline.device_revoked -> 403, refuses malformed rows with a generic 503 + row_malformed audit, echoes attestationState only in the clear response, and the signed JWS claims builder is untouched (tests assert no 'attest' key/value in the decoded payload). Migration 20260910140000 is a new forward file with the latest timestamp; no applied migration or existing comment edited; guard_offline_grant() (create or replace, trigger binding preserved) binds device to (id, user_id), refuses revoked_at, fails closed on unknown state, stamps attestation_state from the device row and refuses caller mismatches, keeps Pro entitlement + immutability checks; issue_offline_grant() dropped/recreated with the 20260908160000 body preserved (api_private.is_active_session(), pg_advisory_xact_lock(access_lock_key(uid)), lease = least(now+7d, verified expiry), free tickets within lifetime_scored_count()+online_reservation_count()+offline_hold_count() <= 2) with 'unattested' no longer a refusal and revoked_at -> offline.device_revoked; EXECUTE grants identical to base (revoke all from public/anon/service_role, grant to authenticated; guard revoked from public/anon/authenticated).
